{
  "object_type": "cabinet",
  "assumptions": [
    "按用户明确要求建模为一个无附加构件的实心长方体；不推断门、层板、背板或内部储物空间。",
    "未提供图像，因此无图像推断；若需要可用储物柜而非实心块，需另行明确内部构造。",
    "模型原点取底面一角，宽沿 X、深沿 Y、高沿 Z。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "单一矩形六面体，尺寸 A × B × ZZYZX = 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.8 m。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "单一柜体块；不拆分板件，不添加任何构件。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：宽度，Length，默认 0.6 m。",
    "B：深度，Length，默认 0.4 m。",
    "ZZYZX：高度，Length，默认 0.8 m。",
    "mat_body：柜体材质，Material，使用通用木质材质默认值。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "材质：mat_body。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：最低且适用的命令级别，直接表达单一轴对齐长方体；无需升级几何命令。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "设置 mat_body 材质并以 BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX 生成唯一实体；不使用变换栈。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用 PROJECT2 3, 270, 2 生成平面投影；2D 脚本保持非空。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "无派生值时无需额外计算；可用 Parameter（Values）脚本限制 A、B、ZZYZX 为正值。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "无需自定义 UI；使用常规参数面板。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "提供单一 mat_body 材质参数，应用于整块几何；不把材质参数解释为附加构件。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "提供宽、深的 2D 可编辑热点，并显示底面外包络。",
    "高度通过 ZZYZX 参数编辑；如需图形化高度拖拽，再补充并验证 3D 高度热点。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "确认 A=0.6 m、B=0.4 m、ZZYZX=0.8 m，且保留标准参数语义。",
    "确认几何仅含一个 BLOCK，无门、层板、背板等附加几何。",
    "确认 2D 脚本非空，且投影范围对应 A × B。",
    "确认长度参数为正值，材质参数有默认值。"
  ],
  "parts": [
    {
      "part_id": "cabinet_solid_body",
      "description": "唯一主体：尺寸由 A、B、ZZYZX 控制的实心长方体。"
    }
  ],
  "typed_parameters": [
    {
      "param_id": "p.width",
      "gdl_name": "A",
      "type": "Length",
      "unit": "m",
      "description": "柜体总宽度。",
      "default_value": 0.6,
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "param_id": "p.depth",
      "gdl_name": "B",
      "type": "Length",
      "unit": "m",
      "description": "柜体总深度。",
      "default_value": 0.4,
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "param_id": "p.height",
      "gdl_name": "ZZYZX",
      "type": "Length",
      "unit": "m",
      "description": "柜体总高度。",
      "default_value": 0.8,
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "param_id": "p.body_material",
      "gdl_name": "mat_body",
      "type": "Material",
      "unit": "n/a",
      "description": "主体材质。",
      "default_value": "Generic Wood",
      "required": true
    }
  ],
  "requirement_mappings": [
    {
      "requirement_id": "explicit_dimensions",
      "text": "宽 600 mm、深 400 mm、高 800 mm；分别使用 A、B、ZZYZX。",
      "kind": "constraint",

        "cabinet_solid_body"

        "p.width",

        "p.height"

      ],

      ],

        "user:明确尺寸与参数名称"
      ]
    },

      "kind": "constraint",

      ],

        "user:无任何附加构件"

      "requirement_id": "unobserved_interior",
      "text": "没有内部结构图像或说明；不将内部构造写成观察事实，按实心体假设处理。",
      "kind": "assumption",
      "part_refs": [
        "cabinet_solid_body"
      ],

        "scripts/3d.gdl"

        "observation:未提供图像或内部结构说明"

  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract",

    "实心块符合无附加构件及尺寸要求，但不具备可用储物空间；若目标是空腔柜体，需另行定义结构。",
    "材质默认值名称需在目标 Archicad 环境中确认可用。"
  ]
}

{
  "object_type": "bookshelf",
  "assumptions": [
    "未提供图像；以下结构均为工程建模假设，不是图像观察结论。",
    "“层板数量”解释为顶板和底板之外的内部层板数量，默认4块；顶板、底板不计入 n_shelves。",
    "采用无背板、开放式板式书架；左右侧板、顶板、底板及内部层板均使用 shelf_thk，未指定的板厚默认18 mm。",
    "尺寸原点位于书架左前底角，宽度沿X、深度沿Y、高度沿Z。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "矩形板件组合成开放式书架；不假设或添加未要求的背板、隔板、五金或装饰。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "左右侧板：各一块，贯穿总高和总深。",
    "顶板与底板：各一块，位于两侧板之间。",
    "内部层板：由 n_shelves 驱动循环，沿高度均匀分布。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A=宽度0.6 m；B=深度0.3 m；ZZYZX=高度1.2 m；均为用户明确值。",
    "n_shelves=4，内部层板数量，可调。",
    "shelf_thk=0.018 m，板件厚度；默认值为假设。",
    "mat_board=板件材质参数，为材质设置所需的附加参数。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "整体尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX",
    "层板设置：n_shelves、shelf_thk",
    "外观：mat_board"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "_inner_w = MAX(0, A - 2 * shelf_thk)",
    "_usable_h = MAX(0, ZZYZX - 2 * shelf_thk)",
    "_shelf_spacing = _usable_h / (n_shelves + 1)，仅在 n_shelves >= 0 时计算",
    "_shelf_z(i) = shelf_thk + i * _shelf_spacing，i 从1到 n_shelves；作为内部层板中心高度"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：所有板件均为矩形长方体，符合最低阶命令；无需升级到拉伸或布尔命令。",
    "ADDX、ADDY、ADDZ 与 DEL：定位板件并配平变换栈。",
    "FOR/NEXT：按 n_shelves 重复生成内部层板。",
    "MATERIAL：应用 mat_board。",
    "PROJECT2 3, 270, 2：生成非空平面投影；HOTSPOT2 用于平面编辑热点。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "先校验并保护尺寸及数量，再设置材质。",
    "用 BLOCK 建立两侧板、顶板、底板；内部层板用 FOR/NEXT 循环生成。",
    "层板宽度取 _inner_w、深度取 B、厚度取 shelf_thk；用中心高度派生位置并换算为板件底面高度。",
    "每个变换均在局部范围内用 DEL 配平；不得依赖 GROUP 布尔或手工展开重复板件。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用 PROJECT2 3, 270, 2 生成俯视投影，确保2D脚本非空。",
    "增加平面外包络的 HOTSPOT2；按需提供 A、B 的成组基点、移动点和参考点热点。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "参数表承载类型和默认值；Values 脚本只负责范围约束与 LOCK，不在其中声明参数或设置类型。",
    "限制 n_shelves 为非负整数（建议0至20）；限制 shelf_thk 为正值且小于可用尺寸。",
    "Master（1D）脚本计算非负的 _inner_w、_usable_h 及层板间距，并保护 n_shelves + 1 不为零。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "可选提供分类为尺寸、层板、材质的简洁参数界面；不改变参数语义或默认值。"

  "material_strategy": [
    "全部板件统一使用 mat_board；未指定木种、表面处理或颜色，材质外观由项目材质库决定。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "平面视图提供 A、B 的基点、移动点和参考点热点组，分别关联宽度与深度。",
    "垂直尺寸编辑可通过立面/剖面相关热点实现；若仅交付平面热点，不宣称 ZZYZX 已可图形编辑。",
    "n_shelves 通过参数界面调整；层板数量改变后由循环自动更新。"
  ],

    "确认 n_shelves 默认4且为非负整数，shelf_thk 默认0.018 m且为正值。",
    "确认 _inner_w 与 _usable_h 不为负；层板循环范围、均布间距和顶底板避让有效。",
    "确认 BLOCK 尺寸非负、每个参数实际驱动几何或材质、变换栈配平。",
    "确认2D脚本非空，含有效 PROJECT2 或等效绘图命令。"

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.6 ! Width
Length B = 0.3 ! Depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.2 ! Height
Integer n_shelves = 4 ! Number of interior shelves
Length shelf_thk = 0.018 ! Shared board thickness
Material mat_board = 0 ! Shared board material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.1 THEN A = 0.1
IF B < 0.1 THEN B = 0.1
IF ZZYZX < 0.1 THEN ZZYZX = 0.1
IF n_shelves < 0 THEN n_shelves = 0
IF n_shelves > 20 THEN n_shelves = 20
IF shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN shelf_thk = 0.001
IF shelf_thk > MIN(A / 2, ZZYZX / 2) THEN shelf_thk = MIN(A / 2, ZZYZX / 2)

_inner_w = MAX(0, A - 2 * shelf_thk)
_usable_h = MAX(0, ZZYZX - 2 * shelf_thk)
_shelf_spacing = _usable_h / (n_shelves + 1)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 A, 0, A, B
LINE2 A, B, 0, B
LINE2 0, B, 0, 0
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
RESOL 16
MATERIAL mat_board

! Left and right side panels
BLOCK shelf_thk, B, ZZYZX
ADDX A - shelf_thk
BLOCK shelf_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! Bottom and top panels
ADD shelf_thk, 0, 0
BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
DEL 1

ADD shelf_thk, 0, ZZYZX - shelf_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
DEL 1

! Interior shelves evenly distributed between bottom and top panels
FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
    _shelf_center_z = shelf_thk + i * _shelf_spacing
    ADD shelf_thk, 0, _shelf_center_z - shelf_thk / 2
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END

VALUES "n_shelves" RANGE [0, 20]
VALUES "shelf_thk" RANGE [0.001, 0.3]

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.90 ! Door width
Length B = 0.16 ! Frame depth
Length ZZYZX = 2.10 ! Door height
Length frame_w = 0.06 ! Door frame width
Length panel_thk = 0.04 ! Door panel thickness
Integer open_direction = 0 ! 0 = left, 1 = right
Material mat_main = 0 ! Main material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.20 THEN A = 0.20
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.20 THEN ZZYZX = 0.20
IF frame_w < 0.02 THEN frame_w = 0.02
IF frame_w > A / 4 THEN frame_w = A / 4
IF frame_w > ZZYZX / 4 THEN frame_w = ZZYZX / 4
IF panel_thk < 0.01 THEN panel_thk = 0.01
IF panel_thk > B THEN panel_thk = B
IF open_direction < 0 THEN open_direction = 0
IF open_direction > 1 THEN open_direction = 1

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

IF open_direction = 0 THEN
    LINE2 frame_w, B / 2, frame_w, B / 2 - (A - 2 * frame_w)
    ARC2 frame_w, B / 2, A - 2 * frame_w, 270, 360
ELSE
    LINE2 A - frame_w, B / 2, A - frame_w, B / 2 - (A - 2 * frame_w)
    ARC2 A - frame_w, B / 2, A - 2 * frame_w, 180, 270
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_main

BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX

ADDX A - frame_w
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADDZ ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK A, B, frame_w
DEL 1

IF open_direction = 0 THEN
    ADD frame_w, B / 2 - panel_thk / 2, 0
    ROTZ -90
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, panel_thk, ZZYZX - frame_w
    DEL 2
ELSE
    ADD A - frame_w, B / 2 - panel_thk / 2, 0
    ROTZ 90
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, panel_thk, ZZYZX - frame_w
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.20, 5.0]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.01, 1.0]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.20, 5.0]
VALUES "frame_w" RANGE [0.02, 0.25]
VALUES "panel_thk" RANGE [0.01, 0.20]
VALUES "open_direction" 0, 1

包围盒不匹配是因为 3D 门板旋转了 90°，使其沿深度方向伸出约 0.78 m。将门板在 3D 中改为关闭状态，并让左右开启方向共用门框内的门板位置；开启方向仍由 2D 符号表达。

检查结果：✅参数名称与类型合法、无重复；✅1D 引用均为已声明参数；✅3D 的 IF/ENDIF、变换栈配对且以 END 结束；✅2D 有热点和投影命令；✅跨脚本参数引用一致。

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_main

BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX

ADDX A - frame_w
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADDZ ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK A, B, frame_w
DEL 1

IF open_direction = 0 THEN
    ! Fixed: 3D 门板保持关闭，避免旋转后超出声明的深度 B
    ADD frame_w, B / 2 - panel_thk / 2, 0
    ROTZ 0
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, panel_thk, ZZYZX - frame_w
    DEL 2
ELSE
    ! Fixed: 右开门板也放在门框内，开启方向由 2D 符号表达
    ADD frame_w, B / 2 - panel_thk / 2, 0
    ROTZ 0
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, panel_thk, ZZYZX - frame_w
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 3.0 ! Member length
Length ZZYZX = 0.15 ! Section total height
Length flange_w = 0.075 ! Flange width
Length flange_t = 0.008 ! Flange thickness
Length web_h = 0.142 ! Web clear height above flange
Length web_t = 0.008 ! Web thickness
Material mat_steel = 1 ! Steel material attribute index

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Derived check value; dimensions remain user-controlled.
section_height_check = web_h + flange_t
! Recommended relationship: ZZYZX = web_h + flange_t.

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Axial extent symbol; the section dimensions remain editable in the parameter panel.
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, flange_w
HOTSPOT2 A, flange_w
RECT2 0, 0, A, flange_w
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! L angle section extruded along local Z. web_h is the clear height above the flange.
section_height_check = web_h + flange_t
MATERIAL mat_steel

! Draw only for positive, non-degenerate, dimensionally consistent inputs.
IF A > 0 AND ZZYZX > 0 AND flange_w > 0 AND flange_t > 0 AND web_h > 0 AND web_t > 0 AND web_t <= flange_w AND ABS(ZZYZX - section_height_check) <= 0.000001 THEN
    HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
    HOTSPOT 0, 0, A
    PRISM_ 6, A, 0, 0, 0, flange_w, 0, 0, flange_w, flange_t, 0, web_t, flange_t, 0, web_t, ZZYZX, 0, 0, ZZYZX, 0
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.001, 1000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.001, 10]
VALUES "flange_w" RANGE [0.001, 10]
VALUES "flange_t" RANGE [0.0001, 1]
VALUES "web_h" RANGE [0.001, 10]
VALUES "web_t" RANGE [0.0001, 1]

问题出在 3D 脚本的绘制条件：截面尺寸不满足原始等式，或 `web_t > flange_w` 时，整个构件都会被跳过。另一个问题是 `web_h` 原先只参与校验，没有驱动截面轮廓。我只修改了 3D 脚本：移除这些会导致几何消失的条件，并用受限的派生尺寸保持轮廓有效；`web_t` 也会直接影响轮廓。

1. ✅ 参数名和类型合法，无重复；尺寸参数为 `Length`，材质为 `Material`。
2. ✅ 1D 脚本引用的参数已声明；派生量 `section_height_check` 有定义。
3. ✅ 3D 脚本的 `IF/ENDIF` 配对，末尾有 `END`；无 `FOR` 或变换需要配对。
4. ✅ 2D 脚本包含热点、矩形绘图命令和 `PROJECT2`。
5. ✅ 跨脚本引用的参数均已声明；修复后 `web_h`、`ZZYZX`、`web_t` 均驱动 3D 几何。

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! L angle section extruded along local Z. web_h is the clear height above the flange.
section_height_check = web_h + flange_t
MATERIAL mat_steel

! Fixed: 用有效截面尺寸代替严格相等校验，避免单独编辑尺寸时跳过绘制。
_effective_flange_t = MIN(flange_t, ZZYZX * 0.5)
_effective_web_h = MIN(web_h, ZZYZX - _effective_flange_t)
_effective_web_t = MIN(web_t, flange_w)

! Draw only for positive, non-degenerate inputs.
! Fixed: 移除尺寸关系和腹板/翼缘宽度限制；派生尺寸确保轮廓仍有效。
IF A > 0 AND ZZYZX > 0 AND flange_w > 0 AND flange_t > 0 AND web_h > 0 AND web_t > 0 THEN
    HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
    HOTSPOT 0, 0, A
    PRISM_ 6, A, 0, 0, 0, flange_w, 0, 0, flange_w, _effective_flange_t, 0, _effective_web_t, _effective_flange_t, 0, _effective_web_t, _effective_flange_t + _effective_web_h, 0, 0, _effective_flange_t + _effective_web_h, 0
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.00 ! Stair width
Length B = 3.36 ! Derived total run
Length ZZYZX = 2.04 ! Derived total rise
Integer stair_steps = 12 ! Number of steps
Length riser_h = 0.17 ! Rise per step
Length tread_w = 0.28 ! Going per step
Length tread_thk = 0.035 ! Tread and assumed riser thickness
Boolean has_riser = 1 ! Show risers
Material mat_stair = 1 ! Shared stair material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF stair_steps < 1 THEN
    stair_steps = 1
ENDIF
IF stair_steps > 100 THEN
    stair_steps = 100
ENDIF
IF riser_h < 0.01 THEN
    riser_h = 0.01
ENDIF
IF tread_w < 0.05 THEN
    tread_w = 0.05
ENDIF
IF tread_thk < 0.005 THEN
    tread_thk = 0.005
ENDIF
IF A < 0.1 THEN
    A = 0.1
ENDIF
IF has_riser < 0 THEN
    has_riser = 0
ENDIF
IF has_riser > 1 THEN
    has_riser = 1
ENDIF

B = stair_steps * tread_w
ZZYZX = stair_steps * riser_h

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_stair

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADD (i - 1) * tread_w, 0, i * riser_h - tread_thk
    BLOCK tread_w, A, tread_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

IF has_riser = 1 THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
        ADD (i - 1) * tread_w, 0, (i - 1) * riser_h
        BLOCK tread_thk, A, riser_h - tread_thk
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "stair_steps" RANGE [1, 100]
VALUES "riser_h" RANGE [0.01, 1.0]
VALUES "tread_w" RANGE [0.05, 1.0]
VALUES "tread_thk" RANGE [0.005, 0.2]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.1, 5.0]
VALUES "has_riser" 0, 1
LOCK "B", "ZZYZX"

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.20 ! Window width
Length B = 0.12 ! Frame depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.50 ! Window height
Length frame_w = 0.06 ! Frame thickness
Length glass_thk = 0.006 ! Glass thickness
Length sash_w = 1.08 ! Opening sash width
Material mat_frame = 0 ! Frame material
Material mat_sash = 0 ! Sash material
Material mat_glass = 0 ! Glass material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF frame_w < 0.02 THEN
    frame_w = 0.02
ENDIF
IF frame_w > MIN(A, ZZYZX) / 4 THEN
    frame_w = MIN(A, ZZYZX) / 4
ENDIF
IF glass_thk < 0.003 THEN
    glass_thk = 0.003
ENDIF
IF glass_thk > B THEN
    glass_thk = B
ENDIF
IF sash_w < 0.10 THEN
    sash_w = 0.10
ENDIF
IF sash_w > A - 2 * frame_w THEN
    sash_w = A - 2 * frame_w
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

RESOL 36
LINE2 frame_w, B / 2, frame_w + sash_w, B / 2
LINE2 frame_w, B / 2, frame_w, B / 2 - sash_w
ARC2 frame_w, B / 2, sash_w, 270, 360

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
RESOL 36

MATERIAL mat_frame
FOR i = 0 TO 1
    ADDX i * (A - frame_w)
    BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
NEXT i

ADD frame_w, 0, 0
BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, B, frame_w
DEL 1

ADD frame_w, 0, ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK A - 2 * frame_w, B, frame_w
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_sash
_sash_rail = frame_w * 0.65
_sash_depth = B * 0.6
_sash_y = (B - _sash_depth) / 2

FOR i = 0 TO 1
    ADD frame_w + i * (sash_w - _sash_rail), _sash_y, frame_w
    BLOCK _sash_rail, _sash_depth, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_w
    DEL 1
NEXT i

ADD frame_w, _sash_y, frame_w

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 2.40 ! Railing total length
Length B = 0.05 ! Railing depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.00 ! Total height
Length post_spacing = 0.12 ! Maximum post spacing
Length post_d = 0.02 ! Post diameter
Length rail_d = 0.04 ! Round rail diameter
Boolean has_bottom_rail = 1 ! Show bottom rail
Material body_material = 1 ! Shared railing material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.05 THEN ZZYZX = 0.05
IF post_spacing < 0.01 THEN post_spacing = 0.01
IF post_d < 0.001 THEN post_d = 0.001
IF rail_d < 0.001 THEN rail_d = 0.001
IF post_d > ZZYZX THEN post_d = ZZYZX
IF rail_d > ZZYZX THEN rail_d = ZZYZX

n_intervals = MAX(1, INT(A / post_spacing + 0.999999))
n_posts = n_intervals + 1
actual_spacing = A / n_intervals
top_rail_axis_z = ZZYZX - rail_d / 2
bottom_rail_axis_z = rail_d / 2

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

LINE2 0, B / 2, A, B / 2
FOR i = 1 TO n_posts
    CIRCLE2 (i - 1) * actual_spacing, B / 2, post_d / 2
NEXT i

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL body_material

FOR i = 1 TO n_posts
    ADD (i - 1) * actual_spacing, B / 2, 0
    CYLIND ZZYZX, post_d / 2
    DEL 1
NEXT i

ADD 0, B / 2, top_rail_axis_z
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
DEL 2

IF has_bottom_rail THEN
    ADD 0, B / 2, bottom_rail_axis_z
    ROTY 90
    CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length pipe_od = 0.1143 ! 管道外径，默认 114.3 mm
Length pipe_thk = 0.006 ! 壁厚，默认 6 mm
Angle bend_angle = 90 ! 弯曲角度，仅允许 45、90、135 度
Length bend_radius = 0.17145 ! 中心线弯曲半径，默认 1.5D
Material mat_pipe = 0 ! 管材材质
[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Validate dimensions and derive safe geometry values.
IF pipe_od < 0.001 THEN pipe_od = 0.001
IF pipe_thk < 0.0001 THEN pipe_thk = 0.0001
IF pipe_thk >= pipe_od / 2 THEN pipe_thk = pipe_od * 0.25
IF bend_radius <= pipe_od / 2 THEN bend_radius = pipe_od

IF bend_angle <> 45 AND bend_angle <> 90 AND bend_angle <> 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 90
ENDIF

pipe_id = pipe_od - 2 * pipe_thk
bend_angle_rad = bend_angle * PI / 180
bend_arc_length = bend_radius * bend_angle_rad
outer_radius = pipe_od / 2
inner_radius = pipe_id / 2
[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Plan projection and editable reference points.
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 bend_radius * SIN(bend_angle * PI / 180), bend_radius * (1 - COS(bend_angle * PI / 180))
HOTSPOT2 0, bend_radius
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2
[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Circular centerline elbow in the local XY plane.
! TUBE is used because the pipe centerline is a curved path.
MATERIAL mat_pipe

_pipe_outer_r = pipe_od / 2
_pipe_inner_r = pipe_od / 2 - pipe_thk
_path_count = 11
_section_count = 16
_segments = 8
_angle_rad = bend_angle * PI / 180

! Outer wall sweep. The first and last path points extend the arc as phantom points.
PUT 0, 0, 0
FOR _i = -1 TO _segments + 1
    _t = _i * _angle_rad / _segments
    PUT bend_radius * SIN(_t), bend_radius * (1 - COS(_t)), 0
NEXT _i
FOR _j = 0 TO _section_count - 1
    _a = 360 * _j / _section_count
    PUT _pipe_outer_r * COS(_a), _pipe_outer_r * SIN(_a)
NEXT _j
TUBE _path_count, _section_count, 1, GET(NSP)

! Inner wall sweep on the same centerline, sized by wall thickness.
PUT 0, 0, 0
FOR _i = -1 TO _segments + 1
    _t = _i * _angle_rad / _segments
    PUT bend_radius * SIN(_t), bend_radius * (1 - COS(_t)), 0
NEXT _i
FOR _j = 0 TO _section_count - 1
    _a = 360 * _j / _section_count
    PUT _pipe_inner_r * COS(_a), _pipe_inner_r * SIN(_a)
NEXT _j
TUBE _path_count, _section_count, 1, GET(NSP)

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.20 ! 单元宽度
Length ZZYZX = 1.50 ! 单元高度
Length mullion_w = 0.05 ! 框架立面宽度
Length mullion_d = 0.12 ! 框架深度
Length glass_thk = 0.03 ! 玻璃嵌入深度
Integer v_divs = 2 ! 宽度方向玻璃格数
Integer h_divs = 2 ! 高度方向玻璃格数
Material mat_frame = 1 ! 框材质
Material mat_glass = 2 ! 玻璃材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.01 THEN ZZYZX = 0.01
IF mullion_w < 0.001 THEN mullion_w = 0.001
IF mullion_d < 0.001 THEN mullion_d = 0.001
IF glass_thk < 0 THEN glass_thk = 0
IF v_divs < 1 THEN v_divs = 1
IF h_divs < 1 THEN h_divs = 1

_frame_w = MIN(mullion_w, MIN(A / v_divs, ZZYZX / h_divs) * 0.8)
_glass_panel_thk = 0.024
_glass_y = MIN(glass_thk, MAX(mullion_d - _glass_panel_thk, 0))
_glass_y = MAX(_glass_y, 0)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX

RECT2 0, 0, A, ZZYZX

_cell_w = A / v_divs
_cell_h = ZZYZX / h_divs

FOR i = 1 TO v_divs - 1
    LINE2 i * _cell_w, 0, i * _cell_w, ZZYZX
NEXT i

FOR j = 1 TO h_divs - 1
    LINE2 0, j * _cell_h, A, j * _cell_h
NEXT j

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_frame

BLOCK mullion_w, mullion_d, ZZYZX
ADD A - mullion_w, 0, 0
    BLOCK mullion_w, mullion_d, ZZYZX
DEL 1

BLOCK A, mullion_d, mullion_w
ADDZ ZZYZX - mullion_w
    BLOCK A, mullion_d, mullion_w
DEL 1

_cell_w = A / v_divs
_cell_h = ZZYZX / h_divs

FOR i = 1 TO v_divs - 1
    ADD i * _cell_w - _frame_w / 2, 0, 0
        BLOCK _frame_w, mullion_d, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
NEXT i

FOR j = 1 TO h_divs - 1
    ADD 0, 0, j * _cell_h - _frame_w / 2
        BLOCK A, mullion_d, _frame_w
    DEL 1
NEXT j

MATERIAL mat_glass
FOR i = 0 TO v_divs - 1
    _x0 = i * _cell_w
    _x1 = (i + 1) * _cell_w
    IF i = 0 THEN _x0 = mullion_w
    IF i > 0 THEN _x0 = i * _cell_w + _frame_w / 2
    IF i = v_divs - 1 THEN _x1 = A - mullion_w
    IF i < v_divs - 1 THEN _x1 = (i + 1) * _cell_w - _frame_w / 2
    _panel_w = _x1 - _x0

    FOR j = 0 TO h_divs - 1
        _z0 = j * _cell_h
        _z1 = (j + 1) * _cell_h
        IF j = 0 THEN _z0 = mullion_w
        IF j > 0 THEN _z0 = j * _cell_h + _frame_w / 2
        IF j = h_divs - 1 THEN _z1 = ZZYZX - mullion_w
        IF j < h_divs - 1 THEN _z1 = (j + 1) * _cell_h - _frame_w / 2
        _panel_h = _z1 - _z0

        IF _panel_w > 0.001 THEN
            IF _panel_h > 0.001 THEN
                ADD _x0, _glass_y, _z0
                    BLOCK _panel_w, _glass_panel_thk, _panel_h
                DEL 1
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    NEXT j
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF col_hw < 0.05 THEN
    col_hw = 0.05
ENDIF
IF col_bf < 0.05 THEN
    col_bf = 0.05
ENDIF
IF col_tf < 0.003 THEN
    col_tf = 0.003
ENDIF
IF col_tw < 0.003 THEN
    col_tw = 0.003
ENDIF
IF col_tw >= col_bf THEN
    col_tw = col_bf * 0.25
ENDIF

IF beam_hw < 0.05 THEN
    beam_hw = 0.05
ENDIF
IF beam_bf < 0.05 THEN
    beam_bf = 0.05
ENDIF
IF beam_tf < 0.003 THEN
    beam_tf = 0.003
ENDIF
IF beam_tw < 0.003 THEN
    beam_tw = 0.003
ENDIF
IF beam_tw >= beam_bf THEN
    beam_tw = beam_bf * 0.25
ENDIF

IF node_h < 0.1 THEN
    node_h = 0.1
ENDIF
IF plate_w < 0.03 THEN
    plate_w = 0.03
ENDIF
IF plate_t < 0.003 THEN
    plate_t = 0.003
ENDIF
IF bolt_d < 0.004 THEN
    bolt_d = 0.004
ENDIF
IF bolt_pitch_x < bolt_d THEN
    bolt_pitch_x = bolt_d
ENDIF
IF bolt_pitch_z < bolt_d THEN
    bolt_pitch_z = bolt_d
ENDIF
IF bolt_rows < 1 THEN
    bolt_rows = 1
ENDIF
IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN
    bolt_cols = 1
ENDIF

col_depth = col_hw + 2 * col_tf
beam_depth = beam_hw + 2 * beam_tf
bolt_group_w = (bolt_cols - 1) * bolt_pitch_x + bolt_d
bolt_group_h = (bolt_rows - 1) * bolt_pitch_z + bolt_d
plate_h = MAX(bolt_group_h + 0.04, 0.08)
IF plate_w < bolt_group_w + 0.04 THEN
    plate_w = bolt_group_w + 0.04
ENDIF
IF node_h < bolt_group_h + 0.04 THEN
    node_h = bolt_group_h + 0.04
ENDIF
A = col_bf
B = col_depth
ZZYZX = node_h

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_column
PRISM_ 12, ZZYZX,
    -col_bf/2, -col_depth/2, 0,
     col_bf/2, -col_depth/2, 0,
     col_bf/2, -col_depth/2+col_tf, 0,
     col_tw/2, -col_depth/2+col_tf, 0,
     col_tw/2, col_depth/2-col_tf, 0,
     col_bf/2, col_depth/2-col_tf, 0,
     col_bf/2, col_depth/2, 0,
    -col_bf/2, col_depth/2, 0,
    -col_bf/2, col_depth/2-col_tf, 0,
    -col_tw/2, col_depth/2-col_tf, 0,
    -col_tw/2, -col_depth/2+col_tf, 0,
    -col_bf/2, -col_depth/2+col_tf, 0

MATERIAL mat_beam
ADD 0, col_bf/2, ZZYZX/2
ROTX -90
PRISM_ 12, beam_depth,
    -beam_bf/2, -beam_depth/2, 0,
     beam_bf/2, -beam_depth/2, 0,
     beam_bf/2, -beam_depth/2+beam_tf, 0,
     beam_tw/2, -beam_depth/2+beam_tf, 0,
     beam_tw/2, beam_depth/2-beam_tf, 0,
     beam_bf/2, beam_depth/2-beam_tf, 0,
     beam_bf/2, beam_depth/2, 0,
    -beam_bf/2, beam_depth/2, 0,
    -beam_bf/2, beam_depth/2-beam_tf, 0,
    -beam_tw/2, beam_depth/2-beam_tf, 0,
    -beam_tw/2, -beam_depth/2+beam_tf, 0,
    -beam_bf/2, -beam_depth/2+beam_tf, 0
DEL 2

MATERIAL mat_plate
ADD 0, col_bf/2, ZZYZX/2-plate_h/2
BLOCK plate_w, plate_t, plate_h
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_bolt
FOR row = 1 TO bolt_rows
    FOR col = 1 TO bolt_cols
        ADD (col-1)*bolt_pitch_x-(bolt_cols-1)*bolt_pitch_x/2, col_bf/2+plate_t, ZZYZX/2+(row-1)*bolt_pitch_z-(bolt_rows-1)*bolt_pitch_z/2
        ROTX -90
        CYLIND plate_t+0.04, bolt_d/2
        ADDZ plate_t+0.04
        CYLIND 0.008, bolt_d*0.8
        DEL 1
        DEL 2
    NEXT col
NEXT row

IF has_stiff THEN
    MATERIAL mat_stiffener
    ADD 0, col_bf/2+plate_t, ZZYZX/2-beam_depth/2
    BLOCK beam_bf, plate_t, beam_tf
    DEL 1
    ADD 0, col_bf/2+plate_t, ZZYZX/2+beam_depth/2-beam_tf
    BLOCK beam_bf, plate_t, beam_tf
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.8 ! 桌面直径
Length B = 0.8 ! 圆形外包络深度，锁定为 A
Length ZZYZX = 0.75 ! 桌面顶面标高
Length top_thk = 0.03 ! 桌面厚度
Integer leg_count = 4 ! 桌腿数量
Length leg_d = 0.05 ! 桌腿直径
Length leg_inset = 0.06 ! 桌腿中心至桌面边缘的内缩量
Material mat_top = 0 ! 桌面材质
Material mat_leg = 0 ! 桌腿材质
[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 参数校验与派生几何约束
IF A < 0.1 THEN A = 0.1
B = A
IF ZZYZX < 0.1 THEN ZZYZX = 0.1
IF top_thk < 0.005 THEN top_thk = 0.005
IF top_thk > ZZYZX - 0.01 THEN top_thk = ZZYZX - 0.01
IF leg_count < 3 THEN leg_count = 3
IF leg_count > 12 THEN leg_count = 12
IF leg_d < 0.01 THEN leg_d = 0.01
IF leg_d > A * 0.5 THEN leg_d = A * 0.5
IF leg_inset < 0 THEN leg_inset = 0
_max_inset = A / 2 - leg_d / 2 - 0.01
IF _max_inset < 0 THEN _max_inset = 0
IF leg_inset > _max_inset THEN leg_inset = _max_inset
leg_h = ZZYZX - top_thk
leg_r = leg_d / 2
leg_radius = A / 2 - leg_inset - leg_d / 2
[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2
RESOL 36
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2
[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
RESOL 36
MATERIAL mat_leg
leg_h = ZZYZX - top_thk
leg_r = leg_d / 2
leg_radius = A / 2 - leg_inset - leg_d / 2
FOR i = 0 TO leg_count - 1
    leg_angle = 360 * i / leg_count
    ADD A / 2 + leg_radius * COS(leg_angle), B / 2 + leg_radius * SIN(leg_angle), 0
    CYLIND leg_h, leg_r
    DEL 1
NEXT i
MATERIAL mat_top
ADDZ ZZYZX - top_thk
CYLIND top_thk, A / 2
DEL 1
END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.6 ! Width
Length B = 0.35 ! Total depth including door
Length ZZYZX = 0.7 ! Height
Integer n_shelves = 2 ! Number of internal shelves
Boolean has_door = 1 ! Show door
Length door_thk = 0.018 ! Door thickness
Integer hinge_side = 1 ! 1=left, 2=right
Length panel_thk = 0.018 ! Assumed cabinet panel thickness
Material mat_body = 0 ! Cabinet body material
Material mat_door = 0 ! Door material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Clamp dimensions and construction parameters to usable values.
IF A < 0.1 THEN A = 0.1
IF B < 0.1 THEN B = 0.1
IF ZZYZX < 0.1 THEN ZZYZX = 0.1
IF n_shelves < 0 THEN n_shelves = 0
IF n_shelves > 20 THEN n_shelves = 20
IF hinge_side <> 1 AND hinge_side <> 2 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF panel_thk < 0.006 THEN panel_thk = 0.006
IF panel_thk > A / 4 THEN panel_thk = A / 4
IF panel_thk > ZZYZX / 4 THEN panel_thk = ZZYZX / 4
IF door_thk < 0.006 THEN door_thk = 0.006
IF door_thk > B - 0.02 THEN door_thk = B - 0.02

! Derived clear dimensions used by the cabinet construction.
_case_depth = B
IF has_door THEN _case_depth = B - door_thk
_back_thk = 0.009
_inner_width = MAX(0, A - 2 * panel_thk)
_inner_height = MAX(0, ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk)
_shelf_spacing = _inner_height / (n_shelves + 1)

! Read host/context values for compatibility with the requested API context.
_host_wall_thickness = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_height = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_tool_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
RESOL 24

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! Cabinet footprint and front edge.
RECT2 0, 0, A, B
LINE2 0, 0, A, 0

! Closed-door edge and a schematic opening arc, when the door is enabled.
IF has_door THEN
    LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
    IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
        ARC2 0, 0, A, 270, 360
        LINE2 0, 0, 0, -A
    ELSE
        ARC2 A, 0, A, 180, 270
        LINE2 A, 0, A, -A
    ENDIF
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Cabinet case depth includes the door only when it is present.
_case_depth = B
IF has_door THEN _case_depth = B - door_thk
_back_thk = 0.009
_inner_width = A - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_height = ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk
_shelf_spacing = _inner_height / (n_shelves + 1)

MATERIAL mat_body

! Left and right side panels.
BLOCK panel_thk, _case_depth, ZZYZX
ADDX A - panel_thk
BLOCK panel_thk, _case_depth, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! Top and bottom panels, fitted between the sides.
ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_width, _case_depth, panel_thk
DEL 1
ADD panel_thk, 0, 0
BLOCK _inner_width, _case_depth, panel_thk
DEL 1

! Back panel, at the rear of the case.
ADD 0, _case_depth - _back_thk, 0
BLOCK A, _back_thk, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! Equally spaced internal shelves.
IF n_shelves > 0 THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
        ADD panel_thk, door_thk, panel_thk + i * _shelf_spacing
        BLOCK _inner_width, _case_depth - door_thk - _back_thk, panel_thk
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

! Single full-height door and simple hinge-side markers.
IF has_door THEN
    MATERIAL mat_door
    BLOCK A, door_thk, ZZYZX

    MATERIAL mat_body
    _hinge_x = 0
    IF hinge_side = 2 THEN _hinge_x = A - 0.025
    _hinge_z1 = ZZYZX * 0.25
    _hinge_z2 = ZZYZX * 0.75
    ADD _hinge_x, -0.006, _hinge_z1
    BLOCK 0.025, 0.006, 0.06
    DEL 1
    ADD _hinge_x, -0.006, _hinge_z2
    BLOCK 0.025, 0.006, 0.06
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.09 ! Compatibility envelope width
Length B = 0.09 ! Compatibility envelope depth
Length ZZYZX = 0.9 ! Total height
Integer seg_count = 3 ! Number of turned shaft segments
Length base_d = 0.09 ! Base diameter
Length top_d = 0.06 ! Top diameter
Material mat_main = 0 ! Main material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF base_d < 0.001 THEN base_d = 0.001
IF top_d < 0.001 THEN top_d = 0.001
IF seg_count < 1 THEN seg_count = 1

_h_seg = ZZYZX / seg_count
_r_base = base_d / 2
_r_top = top_d / 2
_envelope_d = MAX(base_d, top_d)
PARAMETERS A = _envelope_d, B = _envelope_d

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
CIRCLE2 0, 0, A / 2
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_main
TOLER 0.005

! REVOLVE is used because the baluster is a continuous axisymmetric turned form.
! Its inline profile is built from the base diameter, top diameter, height, and segment count.
PUT 0, 0, 1
PUT 0, base_d / 2, 1

FOR i = 1 TO seg_count
    _z_i = i * ZZYZX / seg_count
    _t_i = i / seg_count
    _relief = MIN(base_d, top_d) * 0.03 * SIN(180 * _t_i)
    _r_i = base_d / 2 + (top_d / 2 - base_d / 2) * _t_i + _relief
    PUT _z_i, _r_i, 1
NEXT i

PUT ZZYZX, 0, 1

ROTY -90
REVOLVE NSP / 3, 360, 63, GET(NSP)
DEL 1
END

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_main
TOLER 0.005

! REVOLVE is used because the baluster is a continuous axisymmetric turned form.
! Its inline profile is built from the base diameter, top diameter, height, and segment count.
! Fixed: REVOLVE produced no mesh in preview; use parameter-driven conical segments to generate the turned body.
_r_prev = base_d / 2

FOR i = 1 TO seg_count
    _z_i = i * ZZYZX / seg_count
    _t_i = i / seg_count
    _relief = MIN(base_d, top_d) * 0.03 * SIN(180 * _t_i)
    _r_i = base_d / 2 + (top_d / 2 - base_d / 2) * _t_i + _relief
    ADDZ (i - 1) * (ZZYZX / seg_count)
    CONE ZZYZX / seg_count, _r_prev, _r_i
    DEL 1
    _r_prev = _r_i
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Clamp dimensions and derive the object's overall depth.
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01

IF arm_length < 0.001 THEN arm_length = 0.001
IF bracket_thk < 0.001 THEN bracket_thk = 0.001
IF rail_d < 0.001 THEN rail_d = 0.001
IF bolt_count < 1 THEN bolt_count = 1

B = bracket_thk + arm_length

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL bracket_mat

! Wall plate
BLOCK A, bracket_thk, ZZYZX

! Cantilever arm from the plate's outer face toward the handrail.
ADD A / 2 - bracket_thk / 2, bracket_thk, ZZYZX - bracket_thk
BLOCK bracket_thk, arm_length, bracket_thk
DEL 1

! Open cradle for a round rail; its U-profile is extruded across the plate width.
ADD 0, B - rail_d / 2, ZZYZX - rail_d / 2
ROTY 90
PRISM_ 8, A, -rail_d / 2, -rail_d / 2, 0, rail_d / 2, -rail_d / 2, 0, rail_d / 2, rail_d / 2, 0, rail_d / 4, rail_d / 2, 0, rail_d / 4, 0, 0, -rail_d / 4, 0, 0, -rail_d / 4, rail_d / 2, 0, -rail_d / 2, rail_d / 2, 0
DEL 2

! Simplified bolt heads, evenly spaced on the plate height.
_bolt_radius = bracket_thk * 0.22
_bolt_height = bracket_thk * 0.3
_bolt_pitch = ZZYZX / (bolt_count + 1)
FOR i = 1 TO bolt_count
    ADD A / 2, 0, i * _bolt_pitch
    ROTX -90
    CYLIND _bolt_height, _bolt_radius
    DEL 2
NEXT i

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 3.0 ! Beam length (m)
Length B = 0.15 ! Section width (m)
Length ZZYZX = 0.30 ! Section height (m)
Integer hole_count = 6 ! Number of bolt holes
Length hole_spacing = 0.40 ! Center-to-center spacing (m)
Length hole_d = 0.02 ! Hole diameter (m)
Material mat_steel = 1 ! Steel material attribute index

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Validate dimensions and hole-array inputs.
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.01 THEN ZZYZX = 0.01
IF hole_count < 1 THEN hole_count = 1
hole_count = INT(hole_count)
IF hole_spacing < 0.001 THEN hole_spacing = 0.001
IF hole_d < 0.001 THEN hole_d = 0.001

! Keep the array within the beam and the holes within the section height.
IF hole_count > 1 THEN
    IF hole_spacing * (hole_count - 1) > A THEN
        hole_spacing = A / (hole_count - 1)
    ENDIF
ENDIF
hole_d = MIN(hole_d, ZZYZX * 0.8)

hole_span = (hole_count - 1) * hole_spacing
end_margin = (A - hole_span) / 2
hole_radius = hole_d / 2

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! Show the parameterized hole array in plan.
FOR i = 1 TO hole_count
    hole_x = end_margin + (i - 1) * hole_spacing
    CIRCLE2 hole_x, B / 2, hole_radius
NEXT i

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_steel

! Rectangular beam body.
GROUP "beam_body"
    BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
ENDGROUP

! Cylinders pass fully through the section width along Y.
GROUP "hole_tools"
    FOR i = 1 TO hole_count
        hole_x = end_margin + (i - 1) * hole_spacing
        ADD hole_x, B / 2 + 0.01, ZZYZX / 2
        ROTX 90
        CYLIND B + 0.02, hole_radius
        DEL 2
    NEXT i
ENDGROUP

! Subtract the transverse cylindrical tools from the beam.
beam_with_holes = SUBGROUP("beam_body", "hole_tools")
PLACEGROUP beam_with_holes
KILLGROUP "beam_body"
KILLGROUP "hole_tools"

END

发现梁身尺寸参数本身有效；但孔切除圆柱超出截面宽度，可能导致几何包围盒异常。我将切除体改为从 `y=B` 延伸至 `y=0`，不再超出梁身。同时在 3D 孔位公式中直接使用 `hole_spacing`，使孔阵列随间距变化。

检查结果：✅ 参数名称与类型有效、无重复；✅ 1D 引用的变量均已定义；✅ 3D 的循环、条件与 `END` 配对；✅ 2D 有 `HOTSPOT2` 和 `PROJECT2`；✅ 跨脚本变量引用一致。

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_steel

! Rectangular beam body.
GROUP "beam_body"
    BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
ENDGROUP

! Cylinders pass fully through the section width along Y.
GROUP "hole_tools"
    FOR i = 1 TO hole_count
        ! Fixed: use the spacing parameter directly so hole positions respond to spacing edits.
        hole_x = A / 2 - ((hole_count - 1) * hole_spacing) / 2 + (i - 1) * hole_spacing
        ! Fixed: keep the cutter within the beam width to avoid expanding the evaluated bounds.
        ADD hole_x, B, ZZYZX / 2
        ROTX 90
        CYLIND B, hole_radius
        DEL 2
    NEXT i
ENDGROUP

! Subtract the transverse cylindrical tools from the beam.
beam_with_holes = SUBGROUP("beam_body", "hole_tools")
PLACEGROUP beam_with_holes
KILLGROUP "beam_body"
KILLGROUP "hole_tools"

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 6.0 ! Total span
Length ZZYZX = 1.5 ! Truss height
Integer panel_count = 4 ! Number of triangular panels
Length chord_d = 0.08 ! Member diameter
Material mat_truss = 1 ! Truss material index

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A <= 0 THEN A = 0.001
IF ZZYZX <= 0 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF panel_count < 1 THEN panel_count = 1
IF chord_d <= 0 THEN chord_d = 0.001

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count
_member_radius = chord_d / 2
[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX

LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 0, ZZYZX, A, ZZYZX

FOR i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    IF MOD(i, 2) = 0 THEN
        LINE2 i * A / panel_count, 0, (i + 1) * A / panel_count, ZZYZX
    ELSE
        LINE2 i * A / panel_count, ZZYZX, (i + 1) * A / panel_count, 0
    ENDIF
NEXT i

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2
[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_truss

ADD 0, 0, 0
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, _member_radius
DEL 2

ADD 0, 0, ZZYZX
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, _member_radius
DEL 2

FOR i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    _x = i * _panel_pitch
    _dx = _panel_pitch
    IF MOD(i, 2) = 0 THEN
        _z = 0
        _dz = ZZYZX
    ELSE
        _z = ZZYZX
        _dz = -ZZYZX
    ENDIF

    _member_length = SQR(_dx * _dx + _dz * _dz)
    _angle = ATN(_dx / _dz)
    IF _dz < 0 THEN
        _angle = _angle + 180
    ENDIF

    ADD _x, 0, _z
    ROTY _angle
    CYLIND _member_length, _member_radius
    DEL 2
NEXT i

END

Length A = 2.05 ! Width envelope
Length B = 2.05 ! Depth envelope
Length ZZYZX = 2.88 ! Total height
Integer stair_steps = 16 ! Total number of treads
Length riser_h = 0.18 ! Rise per step
Angle total_angle = 360 ! Total stair rotation
Length tread_w = 0.28 ! Tread tangential width
Length stair_width = 0.90 ! Tread radial projection
Length post_dia = 0.15 ! Center post diameter
Material mat_tread = 1 ! Tread material attribute index
Material mat_post = 1 ! Post material attribute index

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF stair_steps < 1 THEN stair_steps = 1
stair_steps = INT(stair_steps)
IF riser_h < 0.01 THEN riser_h = 0.01
IF tread_w < 0.01 THEN tread_w = 0.01
IF stair_width < 0.01 THEN stair_width = 0.01
IF post_dia < 0.01 THEN post_dia = 0.01
IF total_angle < 0.1 THEN total_angle = 0.1

step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
total_height = stair_steps * riser_h

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
total_height = stair_steps * riser_h
post_radius = post_dia / 2
tread_thk = 0.04

ADD A / 2, B / 2, 0
MATERIAL mat_post
CYLIND total_height, post_radius

MATERIAL mat_tread
FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ROT step_angle
    ADDZ riser_h
    ADD post_radius, -tread_w / 2, -tread_thk / 2
    BLOCK stair_width, tread_w, tread_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i
DEL stair_steps * 2
DEL 1
END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 3.0 ! Base width
Length B = 3.0 ! Base depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.2 ! Ridge height
Length glass_thk = 0.012 ! Glass panel thickness
Material mat_glass = 1 ! Glass material
Material mat_frame = 1 ! Frame material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.1 THEN A = 0.1
IF B < 0.1 THEN B = 0.1
IF ZZYZX < 0.1 THEN ZZYZX = 0.1
IF glass_thk < 0.001 THEN glass_thk = 0.001
IF glass_thk > MIN(A, B) / 20 THEN glass_thk = MIN(A, B) / 20

! Derived dimensions for the four triangular faces
_half_width = A / 2
_half_depth = B / 2
_slope_x = SQR(_half_width * _half_width + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)
_slope_y = SQR(_half_depth * _half_depth + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2
RECT2 0, 0, A, B
LINE2 0, 0, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 A, 0, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 A, B, A / 2, B / 2
LINE2 0, B, A / 2, B / 2
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Frame layout is an engineering assumption: perimeter eaves beams and four hip rafters.
! Glass panels are triangular PRISM_ elements, extruded by glass_thk and assigned mat_glass.

MATERIAL mat_frame

! Perimeter eaves beams
BLOCK A, 0.06, 0.06
ADDY B - 0.06
BLOCK A, 0.06, 0.06
DEL 1

ADD 0, 0, 0
BLOCK 0.06, B, 0.06
ADDX A - 0.06
BLOCK 0.06, B, 0.06
DEL 1

! Four assumed hip rafters, oriented from each base corner toward the apex
_hip_length = SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)
_hip_yaw = ATN(B / A)
_hip_pitch = ATN(ZZYZX / SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2)))

ADD 0, 0, 0
ROTZ _hip_yaw
ROTY -_hip_pitch
BLOCK _hip_length, 0.06, 0.06
DEL 3

ADD A, 0, 0
ROTZ 180 - _hip_yaw
ROTY -_hip_pitch
BLOCK _hip_length, 0.06, 0.06

BLOCK A, 0.06, 0.06

BLOCK A, 0.06, 0.06

BLOCK 0.06, B, 0.06

! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
_lint_dx = A
_lint_dy = B

    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _hip_yaw = 90 ELSE _hip_yaw = -90

    _hip_yaw = ATN(_lint_dy / _lint_dx)

Length A = 0.9 ! Installation face width (m)
Length ZZYZX = 1.2 ! Installation face height (m)
Integer blade_count = 8 ! Number of blades
Angle blade_angle = 30 ! Blade tilt angle (degrees)
Length blade_depth = 0.18 ! Blade depth (m)
Material mat_blade = 1 ! Blade material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.01 THEN ZZYZX = 0.01
IF blade_depth < 0.001 THEN blade_depth = 0.001
IF blade_count < 1 THEN blade_count = 1
blade_spacing = ZZYZX / blade_count

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX
RECT2 0, 0, A, ZZYZX
FOR i = 1 TO blade_count
    LINE2 0, (i - 0.5) * ZZYZX / blade_count, A, (i - 0.5) * ZZYZX / blade_count
NEXT i
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_blade
blade_thickness = 0.025
blade_spacing = ZZYZX / blade_count
FOR i = 1 TO blade_count
    ADD 0, 0, (i - 0.5) * blade_spacing
    ROTX blade_angle
    ADD 0, -blade_depth / 2, -blade_thickness / 2
    BLOCK A, blade_depth, blade_thickness
    DEL 3
NEXT i
END

IF strut_d < 0.001 THEN strut_d = 0.001

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
node_rad = node_r / 2
strut_rad = strut_d / 2
golden_angle = 137.507764

MATERIAL mat_node
SPHERE node_rad

MATERIAL mat_strut
FOR i = 1 TO strut_count
    z_dir = 1 - 2 * (i - 0.5) / strut_count
    radial = SQR(MAX(0, 1 - z_dir * z_dir))
    phi = i * golden_angle
    x_dir = radial * COS(phi)
    y_dir = radial * SIN(phi)

    ADD node_rad * x_dir, node_rad * y_dir, node_rad * z_dir
    ROTZ phi
    ROTY ACS(z_dir)
    CYLIND strut_length, strut_rad
    DEL 3
NEXT i

END

VALUES "strut_length" RANGE [0.001, 10]

问题位于 3D 杆件的旋转顺序：方位角旋转未正确参与杆件轴向定位，导致多个方向的实际包围尺寸明显小于声明值。将两次旋转调换，其余代码保持不变。

1. ✅ 参数名称、类型合法，无重复。
2. ✅ Master 脚本引用的变量均已声明；尺寸计算有参数依据。
3. ✅ 3D 脚本的 FOR/NEXT、变换栈配平，末尾有 END。
4. ✅ 2D 脚本含热点及 PROJECT2。
5. ✅ 跨脚本变量引用一致。

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
node_rad = node_r / 2
strut_rad = strut_d / 2
golden_angle = 137.507764

MATERIAL mat_node
SPHERE node_rad

MATERIAL mat_strut
FOR i = 1 TO strut_count
    z_dir = 1 - 2 * (i - 0.5) / strut_count
    radial = SQR(MAX(0, 1 - z_dir * z_dir))
    phi = i * golden_angle
    x_dir = radial * COS(phi)
    y_dir = radial * SIN(phi)

    ADD node_rad * x_dir, node_rad * y_dir, node_rad * z_dir
    ROTY ACS(z_dir) ! Fixed: 先倾斜局部 Z 轴，再应用方位角，使杆件朝向球面采样方向
    ROTZ phi
    CYLIND strut_length, strut_rad
    DEL 3
NEXT i

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.78 ! Envelope width

Angle total_angle = 360 ! Total rotation angle
Length tread_w = 0.28 ! Radial tread width
Length center_radius = 0.10 ! Center column radius
Length tread_thk = 0.04 ! Tread thickness
Length inner_clearance = 0.01 ! Clearance from column
Material mat_tread = 1 ! Tread material
Material mat_column = 1 ! Center column material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF stair_steps < 1 THEN stair_steps = 1
IF riser_h < 0.01 THEN riser_h = 0.01
IF total_angle < 0 THEN total_angle = 0
IF tread_w < 0.01 THEN tread_w = 0.01
IF center_radius < 0.01 THEN center_radius = 0.01
IF tread_thk < 0.001 THEN tread_thk = 0.001
IF inner_clearance < 0 THEN inner_clearance = 0

step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
total_rise = stair_steps * riser_h
inner_radius = center_radius + inner_clearance
outer_radius = inner_radius + tread_w

A = 2 * outer_radius
B = 2 * outer_radius
ZZYZX = total_rise

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B / 2

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

CIRCLE2 0, 0, center_radius
FOR i = 0 TO stair_steps
    angle_i = i * step_angle
    LINE2 inner_radius * COS(angle_i), inner_radius * SIN(angle_i), outer_radius * COS(angle_i), outer_radius * SIN(angle_i)
NEXT i

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_column
CYLIND total_rise, center_radius

MATERIAL mat_tread
FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    PRISM_ 4, tread_thk, inner_radius, 0, 0, outer_radius, 0, 0, outer_radius * COS(step_angle), outer_radius * SIN(step_angle), 0, inner_radius * COS(step_angle), inner_radius * SIN(step_angle), 0
    ADDZ riser_h
    ROT step_angle
NEXT i
DEL 2 * stair_steps

END

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
PEN 1
frame_w = MIN(A, B) * 0.04
IF frame_w < 0.03 THEN frame_w = 0.03
IF frame_w > MIN(A, B) / 8 THEN frame_w = MIN(A, B) / 8
MATERIAL mat_glass

! Four triangular glass panels, extruded by glass_thk normal to each slope.
_slopeY = ATN(ZZYZX / (B / 2))
ADDX 0
ADDY -B / 2
ROTX _slopeY
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -A / 2, 0, 0, A / 2, 0, 0, 0, SQR((B / 2) * (B / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

_slopeY = ATN(ZZYZX / (B / 2))
ROTZ 180
ADDY B / 2
ROTX -_slopeY
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -A / 2, 0, 0, A / 2, 0, 0, 0, -SQR((B / 2) * (B / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

_slopeX = ATN(ZZYZX / (A / 2))
ROTZ 90
ADDY -A / 2
ROTX _slopeX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -B / 2, 0, 0, B / 2, 0, 0, 0, SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

_slopeX = ATN(ZZYZX / (A / 2))
ROTZ 270
ADDY -A / 2
ROTX _slopeX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -B / 2, 0, 0, B / 2, 0, 0, 0, SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

! Bottom perimeter frame.
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, 0
BLOCK A, frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD -A / 2, B / 2 - frame_w, 0
BLOCK A, frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2 + frame_w, 0
BLOCK frame_w, B - 2 * frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD A / 2 - frame_w, -B / 2 + frame_w, 0
BLOCK frame_w, B - 2 * frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1

! Four corner-to-apex support rods.
_support_len = SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)
_support_tilt = ATN(SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2)) / ZZYZX)
_support_az = ATN(B / A)
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, 0
ROTZ 180 + _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD A / 2, -B / 2, 0
ROTZ 360 - _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD A / 2, B / 2, 0
ROTZ _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD -A / 2, B / 2, 0
ROTZ 180 - _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
END

    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _slopeX = _slopeX + 180
ENDIF
ROTZ 90
ADDY -A / 2
ROTX _slopeX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -B / 2, 0, 0, B / 2, 0, 0, 0, SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
_lint_dx = (A / 2)
_lint_dy = ZZYZX
IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _slopeX = 90 ELSE _slopeX = -90
ELSE
    _slopeX = ATN(_lint_dy / _lint_dx)
    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _slopeX = _slopeX + 180
ENDIF
ROTZ 270
ADDY -A / 2
ROTX _slopeX
PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, -B / 2, 0, 0, B / 2, 0, 0, 0, SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX), 0
DEL 3

! Bottom perimeter frame.
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, 0
BLOCK A, frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD -A / 2, B / 2 - frame_w, 0
BLOCK A, frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2 + frame_w, 0
BLOCK frame_w, B - 2 * frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1
ADD A / 2 - frame_w, -B / 2 + frame_w, 0
BLOCK frame_w, B - 2 * frame_w, frame_w
DEL 1

! Four corner-to-apex support rods.
_support_len = SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)
! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
_lint_dx = ZZYZX
_lint_dy = SQR((A / 2) * (A / 2) + (B / 2) * (B / 2))
IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _support_tilt = 90 ELSE _support_tilt = -90
ELSE
    _support_tilt = ATN(_lint_dy / _lint_dx)
    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _support_tilt = _support_tilt + 180
ENDIF
! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
_lint_dx = A
_lint_dy = B
IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _support_az = 90 ELSE _support_az = -90
ELSE
    _support_az = ATN(_lint_dy / _lint_dx)
    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _support_az = _support_az + 180
ENDIF
ADD -A / 2, -B / 2, 0
! Fixed: 将左下角支承框方位改为指向中心顶点
ROTZ _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD A / 2, -B / 2, 0
! Fixed: 将右下角支承框方位改为指向中心顶点
ROTZ 180 - _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD A / 2, B / 2, 0
! Fixed: 将右上角支承框方位改为指向中心顶点
ROTZ 180 + _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
ADD -A / 2, B / 2, 0
! Fixed: 将左上角支承框方位改为指向中心顶点
ROTZ 360 - _support_az
ROTY _support_tilt
CYLIND _support_len, frame_w / 2
DEL 3
END
